name: polis
description: A project dashboard and isometric city map: progress, tasks, agents, resources, processes and skills

estimate.title: Expected resources
estimate.description: How a prompt's expected cost is sized: both (history, plus a small-model estimate for long prompts), history (free), or model (a small-model call on every prompt)

guidance.title: Guide Claude
guidance.description: Add a short standing instruction so Claude keeps tasks and project milestones current, and offer it the project tool

autoOpen.title: Open the dashboard by itself
autoOpen.description: Open the Polis pane the first time tasks or agents appear in a session

motion.title: Animate the city
motion.description: Let the city move: its cars, its boat, its fireworks. Off draws it still

page.title: Page on disk
page.description: Write the city to .polis/city.html in the project each time the board changes, for a browser or preview tab left open
